key_notes: Stack LIFO using list append and pop
topics.example_code:
# Stack LIFO using list append and pop
    stack = []
    stack.append(1)
    stack.append(2)
    print("Stack pop:", stack.pop())

    # Queue FIFO using collections.deque popleft
    queue = deque(["a", "b", "c"])
    print("Queue popleft:", queue.popleft())

    # Priority queue min-heap using heapq
    heap = []
    heapq.heappush(heap, (2, "Medium"))
    heapq.heappush(heap, (1, "High"))
    heapq.heappush(heap, (3, "Low"))
    print("Heap pop highest priority:", heapq.heappop(heap))

bst = BinarySearchTree()
    for val in [50, 30, 70, 20, 40]:
        bst.insert(val)
    print("BST In-order:", bst.inorder(bst.root))
